item.title: No sound Guitar Rig
item.description:
No sound from Motu 2 using Guitar Rig

  1. check sound source
  2. check if Motu 2 is default Output
  3. Switch ON/OFF Motu 2
  4. Check Settings Ableton Live -Audio- M2
  5. Check volume settings, MOTU . Logitech speakers, sound source , In/Out in Guitar Rig
